## Validators and revalidation

A server may identify a representation with an ETag or a Last-Modified timestamp. To revalidate an expired cached representation, send If-None-Match with its ETag, or If-Modified-Since with its timestamp when no entity tag is available. A 304 Not Modified response tells the client to reuse its stored representation rather than download the body again. Update cached metadata using the validation response. Cache-Control governs freshness and whether storage or revalidation is permitted.

## Private and sensitive responses

A shared cache must not treat personalized account data as public simply because the request succeeded. Respect Cache-Control: private and no-store. The Vary header identifies request fields that select a representation, so cache keys must incorporate those fields correctly. An ETag is an opaque validator, not a guaranteed content hash or an authorization token. Revalidation does not grant permission to reveal a representation to another user.
